note: The devasthanam sets out two tellings. This episode deliberately follows its **second** account from penance to the woman’s dream. The better-known version places Yada’s penance in the cave and his own fivefold vision there. Keep that variant for the description if wanted. The narration omits the source’s judgement about community worship and leaves the reason for the move unstated.
